message: No callable Google Ads Keyword Planner tool was exposed in the configured tool set. Composio discovery returned Semrush tools instead, which were not used because Phase 2 specifies Keyword Planner and GSC as approved sources.

retry.reason: This was a missing-capability failure, not a transient timeout or 5xx response.

next_action: Expose the approved google_ads_generate_keyword_ideas tool and configure GOOGLE_ADS_PLATFORM_ID, then rerun Phase 2 to populate volume and difficulty fields.
